messages:
maria: Quick sync — Nimbus Cloud + EdgeBox HW bundle + Horizon SI co-announce. We need to lock embargo window, marketplace listing assets, and the redistribution/licensing addendum. Who can own which pieces?

alex: I can take the tech checklist. Items off the top of my head: validated quantized weights allowed, delivery artefact formats (OCI image vs tarball), supported regions (geo-block list), and support handoff.

tara (Legal): Important: we need a redistribution addendum signed before publish. Also require a provenance manifest inside the bundle and a short consumer-facing usage note about downstream obligations. Example clause we want in the addendum:
```
Redistribution Addendum (excerpt):
Vendor grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to redistribute the Model Artifact under the Vendor License for the purposes of hosting, marketplace distribution, and private deployment. Redistribution must include provenance metadata and the original license file. Customer usage is subject to Vendor License; Redwood will not alter license terms.
```
Please don't treat this as final legal text — I'll circulate a redline by EOD.

sam: For SI integration (Horizon) — they expect an OCI image + helm chart for quick install into client clusters. Also a small manifest.json with these fields: `model_version`, `quant_spec`, `provenance_uri`, `supported_hw`. Example manifest snippet:
```json
{"model_version":"v1.2.0","quant_spec":"int8-symmetric","provenance_uri":"https://storage.redwood/models/nimbus/v1.2.0/provenance.json","supported_hw":["edgebox-a100","edgebox-rtx"]}
```
If we can't do OCI for a partner, fallback is a signed tarball and SHA256.

jordan: GTM notes: Nimbus marketing wants a joint launch week (coordinated social + marketplace spotlight). Proposed embargo: 2027-01-15 09:00 PT. Marketing needs final copy + assets by 2026-12-20. Also confirm logo usage guidelines from EdgeBox and Nimbus legal. :party:

devrel: I'll produce a sample integration repo (quickstart) that wires the model to a demo app and a smoke test. Plan: CI that runs basic generate/embedding QPS on a tiny infra matrix (cpu/gpu). Will include `quickstart/README.md` and a simple `docker-compose` + `k8s` example.

alex: One more tech question for Legal: can we include a small inference benchmark in the bundle (macros for perf claims)? If we publish numbers in marketplace listing we need partner approval.

tara (Legal): Yes — all benchmark claims require partner signoff. We'll add an approvals checkbox in the addendum. Also passing on the export control screening (EdgeBox countries list) — ops to confirm.

maria: Cool — owners: Legal (tara) -> signable addendum; Marketing (jordan) -> assets/copy; Eng (alex/sam) -> artefacts & manifest; DevRel (devrel) -> quickstart + CI. Ops to confirm geo block list (cc @deploy-bot). Can each owner reply with 'ack' and ETA?

deploy-bot: ticket created: PARTNERS-4821 "Nimbus/EdgeBox marketplace bundle: addendum + artefacts" assigned to tara, alex, sam, jordan, devrel. Due 2026-12-20.

tara (Legal): ack — draft by 2026-11-30, final by 2026-12-15.

alex: ack — artefact formats and manifest by 2026-12-08.

sam: ack — helm+OCI prototype by 2026-12-12, fallback tarball pipeline by 2026-12-15.

jordan: ack — assets and copy by 2026-12-20, will chase partner brand approvals week of 2026-12-01.

devrel: ack — quickstart + CI by 2026-12-18.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30m sync next week to unblock any cross-dep issues. If legal needs earlier input from eng on provenance fields ping @alex.

alex: noted — I'll drop a minimal provenance schema in the thread after this.

maria: :thumbsup:
